tests.title: RegisterRoutes mounts POST and GET /workspaces/:slug/tokens on the API group behind authentication
given: an echo instance with an auth middleware that injects AuthInfo from a test header and an /api/v1 group
boundtoken.RegisterRoutes(group, Config{DB, APIKit stub, Audit recorder}) has been called
tests.when: the registered routes are listed and POST and GET /api/v1/workspaces/s/tokens are sent without credentials
then: both routes exist with the template /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/tokens
both requests are answered 401 by the middleware/handler chain
the apikit stub receives no request
tests.pseudocode: routes = e.Routes(); assert has(POST,tmpl) && has(GET,tmpl); assert do(POST).status==401 && do(GET).status==401; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: Minting with no credential is answered 401 without contacting apikit
given: a handler reached with apikit.GetAuthInfo returning nil
a stub apikit handler counting calls
tests.when: POST /workspaces/s/tokens is called
then: status is 401
error message is authentication required
the stub is called 0 times
tests.pseudocode: r = post(noAuth); assert r.status==401; assert msg(r)=='authentication required'; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: A PAT bound to any workspace, including the path's own, is refused with token_bound and reported
given: a PAT with token id T bound to workspace S in token_workspace_bindings
a registered refusal observer recording reports
active workspaces S and X
tests.when: POST /workspaces/S/tokens and POST /workspaces/X/tokens are called with that PAT
then: both answers are 403 with error_type token_bound and message 'this token is bound to workspace S'
each request produced one report with status 403 and surface api
the stub apikit is not called and no pats row is created
tests.pseudocode: for slug in [S,X]: r=post(slug, pat T); assert 403, type=='token_bound', msg=='this token is bound to workspace S'; assert reports[-1].Status==403 && Surface=='api'; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: A binding lookup database error for a PAT caller answers 500
given: a PAT caller
the token_workspace_bindings table dropped so the lookup errors
tests.when: POST /workspaces/s/tokens is called
then: status is 500
message is internal server error
the stub apikit is not called
tests.pseudocode: drop(bindings); r=post(pat); assert r.status==500 && msg=='internal server error'; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: An admin token cannot mint a bound token
given: an admin_token caller
an active workspace owned by some user

message is "admin tokens cannot mint bound tokens; a real user is required as the token's owner"
the stub apikit is not called
tests.pseudocode: r=post(admin); assert r.status==403; assert msg=="admin tokens cannot mint bound tokens; a real user is required as the token's owner"; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: Missing workspace, denied access and a non-owner caller all answer 404 workspace not found
given: workspace A owned by user u1, workspace B owned by u2
an authorization state in which wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace would allow u1 on B (e.g. org-member read access) but owner_id differs
tests.when: u1 posts to /workspaces/missing/tokens, to /workspaces/B/tokens, and u2's API key posts to /workspaces/A/tokens
then: each answer is 404 with message workspace not found
the stub apikit is not called
tests.pseudocode: for slug,caller in cases: r=post(slug,caller); assert r.status==404 && msg=='workspace not found'; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: The owner of an archived workspace is refused with 400 workspace is not active
given: an archived workspace owned by u1
tests.when: u1 posts to /workspaces/s/tokens with an API key
then: status is 400
message is workspace is not active
the stub apikit is not called
tests.pseudocode: r=post(owner,'archived-ws'); assert r.status==400 && msg=='workspace is not active'; assert stub.calls==0

tests.title: apikit is invoked exactly when all six checks pass and the first failing check wins
given: a stub apikit handler counting calls that returns 201
a generator of caller states: no credential, bound PAT (with/without lookup error), admin, api_key, PAT lacking tokens:manage; workspace states: missing, other owner, archived, active
tests.when: for any combination of caller state and workspace state, POST /workspaces/:slug/tokens is called
then: the stub call count is 1 iff the credential exists, is an unbound non-admin owner of an active workspace
otherwise the status equals the status of the first failing check in order 401, 403 bound, 403 admin, 404, 400
hub performs no tokens:manage check of its own (a PAT without tokens:manage that passes the checks still reaches apikit)
tests.pseudocode: for (c,w) in product(callers,workspaces): r=post(c,w); expected=firstFailing(c,w); assert (stub.calls==1)==(expected==None); if expected: assert r.status==expected.status

tests.title: The inner request carries the caller's body, Authorization header, content headers and context
given: a recording stub apikit handler returning 201 with a valid body
an owner API key and an active workspace
a request context carrying a marker value
tests.when: the owner posts a body with arbitrary bytes (including whitespace and unknown fields) to /api/v1/workspaces/s/tokens
then: the stub receives exactly one request
its method is POST and its path is /api/v1/user/tokens
its body bytes equal the caller's bytes
its Authorization header equals the caller's verbatim, Content-Type and Content-Length are set
its request context carries the marker
tests.pseudocode: assert stub.calls==1; assert stub.req.Method=='POST' && stub.req.URL.Path=='/api/v1/user/tokens'; assert bytes.Equal(stub.body, sent); assert stub.req.Header['Authorization']==sent.Authorization; assert stub.ctx.Value(k)==marker

tests.title: The inner path is the route template minus /workspaces/:slug/tokens plus /user/tokens
given: a generator of mount prefixes (empty, /api/v1, /x, /a/b/c)
a recording stub apikit and routes mounted at each prefix

then: the stub sees the path P/user/tokens
/api/v1 yields /api/v1/user/tokens and /x yields /x/user/tokens
tests.pseudocode: for P in gen_prefixes(): mount(P); post(P+'/workspaces/s/tokens'); assert stub.path==P+'/user/tokens'

tests.title: Any non-201 apikit answer is copied to the caller unchanged with no binding and no event
given: a stub apikit answering in turn 400 bad body, 400 unknown scope, 403 missing tokens:manage, 403 escalation, 400 bad expires, each with its own Content-Type and body bytes
a recording audit emitter

then: caller status, Content-Type and body are byte-identical to the stub's
token_workspace_bindings has no rows
the emitter recorded no hub.token.bind event
tests.pseudocode: for ans in answers: r=post(); assert r.status==ans.status && r.ct==ans.ct && r.body==ans.body; assert count(bindings)==0; assert emitter.events==[]

tests.title: A 201 with an undecodable body or an empty token_id or token yields 500 and revokes a known token
given: a pats table with a live row for token id T
a stub apikit answering 201 with (a) invalid JSON, (b) token_id T and empty token, (c) empty token_id with a token, (d) token_id T with empty token_id field removed
tests.when: the owner posts to /workspaces/s/tokens for each case
then: status is 500 with message failed to bind the token to the workspace
when a token_id is known the pats row has revoked_at set
no binding row is written
logs contain the token_id at most and never the token
tests.pseudocode: for case: r=post(); assert 500 && msg=='failed to bind the token to the workspace'; if case.knownId: assert revoked_at(T) != NULL; assert count(bindings)==0; assert !contains(logs, case.token)

tests.title: A decodable 201 writes exactly one binding row for the token naming the slug
given: a real SQLite database with workspaces, pats and bindings tables
a stub apikit that inserts a pats row and answers 201 with token_id T and a token
tests.when: the owner posts to /workspaces/s/tokens
then: token_workspace_bindings holds exactly one row for T
the row's slug is s and created_at is a valid UTC timestamp
wsaccess's conditional insert writes nothing when no workspaces row exists for the slug
tests.pseudocode: post(); rows=select * from bindings where token_id=T; assert len(rows)==1 && rows[0].slug=='s'; assert wsaccess.InsertBinding(db,'U','ghost',now) reports no row written

tests.title: Success answers 201 with no-store and the documented body
given: a stub apikit answering 201 {token_id,name,token,permissions,expires_at,created_at}
a workspace s
tests.when: the owner posts to /workspaces/s/tokens
then: status is 201 and Cache-Control is no-store
body has exactly the keys token_id, token, name, permissions, workspace, expires_at, created_at
workspace equals s and all other values equal apikit's response
tests.pseudocode: r=post(); assert r.status==201 && r.h['Cache-Control']=='no-store'; assert keys(r.json)==set(7 keys); assert r.json.workspace=='s'; assert r.json.token==stub.token

tests.title: A workspace deleted between apikit's 201 and the insert yields 404 and a revoked token
given: a stub apikit that creates the pats row and, before answering 201, deletes the workspace row (simulating a concurrent deletion)
tests.when: the owner posts to /workspaces/s/tokens
then: status is 404 with message workspace not found
the pats row has revoked_at set
token_workspace_bindings has no row for the token
tests.pseudocode: stub.beforeReply = delete workspace s; r=post(); assert r.status==404 && msg=='workspace not found'; assert revoked_at(T)!=NULL; assert count(bindings)==0

tests.title: A binding insert error or primary-key conflict yields 500 and a revoked token
given: case A: the bindings table is dropped after apikit's 201
case B: a binding row for the same token_id already exists

then: status is 500 with message failed to bind the token to the workspace
the token's pats row has revoked_at set
no new binding row was written
tests.pseudocode: for case: r=post(); assert r.status==500 && msg=='failed to bind the token to the workspace'; assert revoked_at(T)!=NULL

tests.title: A failing revocation is logged with both errors and the token_id and does not change the answer
given: a captured error-level logger
a failed insert (bindings table dropped) and a revocation that also fails (pats table dropped or read-only)
tests.when: the owner posts to /workspaces/s/tokens for the insert-error, vanished-workspace and undecodable-body variants
then: the statuses and messages are 500/500, 404/workspace not found and 500 respectively, as without the revocation failure
the log holds an error-level line naming the token_id and both errors

tests.title: No log line on any path contains the plaintext token, apikit's 201 body or the Authorization value
given: a captured logger at debug level
a distinctive plaintext token string and Authorization value
paths: success, passthrough error, undecodable 201, vanished workspace, insert error, revocation failure, audit emit error
tests.when: each path is run through the mint handler
then: no captured log output contains the token string, the apikit 201 body or the Authorization value
the plaintext token appears only in the 201 response body of the success path
tests.pseudocode: for p in paths: run(p); assert !contains(logs, token) && !contains(logs, authz) && !contains(logs, apikitBody); for non-success: assert !contains(resp.body, token)

tests.title: For any failure injected after apikit's 201 the token is revoked and unbound when the response is written
given: a stub apikit that inserts a pats row and answers 201
a failure injector over: undecodable body, vanished workspace, insert error, key conflict

then: status is 404 or 500

tests.title: The listing returns every binding joined with pats, ordered, including revoked and expired, omitting orphans
given: a real SQLite database with three bindings on s: one live, one revoked, one expired, with different pats created_at (two equal) and one binding whose pats row is missing

tests.title: Listing renders permissions as an array, nulls for unset times, and never any secret
